ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is an isoline distribution of land production potential within the outline of Shanxi Province. The isoline values are roughly from about 700 in the north, gradually increasing southward to 750, 800, 850, and 900, and reaching about 950 near the southwest, showing a trend of increasing from north to south, especially toward the southwest. Then infer: This large-scale, continuous north-south difference mainly corresponds to differences in heat and moisture conditions between the north and south of Shanxi Province. The south has a lower latitude, better heat conditions, and a relatively more favorable combination of water and heat, so land production potential is higher; the north has relatively poorer heat and moisture conditions, so the potential is lower. Therefore, the main factor affecting the level of land production potential in the figure is climate.
